v_m.name: Verb with an m- prefix (mag-, ma-, mang-, maka-, maki-, magpa-, ...)

v_i.name: Verb with i- (i-, ipag-, ipa-, ika-)

v_compl.name: Completive form of a progressive -in verb

transforms.name: -ng
transforms.description: Linker: -ng after a vowel, -g after n, joins a word to the word it modifies (magandang umaga, kaibigang tapat, gusto kong).

transforms.name: 'y
transforms.description: ay written as 'y after a vowel (ako'y, siya'y).

transforms.name: 't
transforms.description: at (and) written as 't after a vowel (isa't isa, iba't iba).

transforms.name: 'ng
transforms.description: ang written as 'ng after a vowel (ano'ng, sino'ng).

transforms.name: 't spelling
transforms.description: Older spellings of conjunctions with an apostrophe before the final t (subali't, bagama't, datapuwa't, pagka't).

transforms.name: hyphen
transforms.description: The hyphen between a prefix ending in a consonant and a root starting with a vowel, left out (magaral → mag-aral, pagibig → pag-ibig).

transforms.name: nakaka-
transforms.description: Causing a feeling or state, in speech (nakakatawa → tawa, nakakapagod → pagod, nakakahiya → hiya).

transforms.name: completive
transforms.description: Completive aspect: n- instead of m- (nagluto → magluto, natulog → matulog), the infix -in- (kinain → kain, sinulatan → sulatan, ininom → inom, niluto → luto), and i- with -in- (isinulat → isulat, iniluto → iluto).

transforms.name: progressive
transforms.description: Progressive aspect: realis and the reduplicated first syllable of the root (nagluluto → magluto, kumakain → kumain, kinakain → kain, sinusulatan → sulatan, isinusulat → isulat), or of the prefix in speech (nakakakain, nagpapaluto).

transforms.name: contemplative
transforms.description: Contemplative aspect: the reduplicated first syllable of the root (magluluto → magluto, kakain → kumain, kakainin → kainin, susulatan → sulatan, isusulat → isulat), or of the prefix in speech (makakakain, magpapaluto).

transforms.name: contemplative or plural
transforms.description: The reduplicated first syllable after ma-: the contemplative of a ma- verb (matutulog → matulog) or the plural of a ma- adjective (magaganda → maganda, malalaki → malaki).

transforms.name: recently completed
transforms.description: Recently completed action: ka- and the reduplicated first syllable of the root (kakakain → kain, kararating → dating), or kaka- in speech (kakaalis → alis).

transforms.name: abilitative
transforms.description: Ability or chance: makapag- of a mag- verb (makapagluto → magluto), mai- of an i- verb (maibigay → ibigay), maipa- and maipag- (maipaliwanag → ipaliwanag).

transforms.name: social
transforms.description: Doing something with others: makipag- of a mag- verb (makipaglaro → maglaro, makipag-usap → mag-usap).

transforms.name: -um-
transforms.description: Actor focus -um-, after the first consonant of the root or before a vowel (kumain → kain, sumulat → sulat, uminom → inom).

transforms.name: mag-
transforms.description: Actor focus mag- (magluto → luto, mag-aral → aral, magmadali → madali).

transforms.name: magsi-
transforms.description: Plural actor (magsikain → kain, nagsialis → alis, magsipagluto → magluto).

transforms.name: ma-
transforms.description: ma- adjectives and verbs (maganda → ganda, matulog → tulog), with d → r (marami → dami).

transforms.name: mang-
transforms.description: Actor focus mang-, which merges with the root's first consonant: mam- for b and p (mamili → bili, pili), man- for d, s and t (manahi → tahi), mang- for k and the vowels (mangisda → isda).

transforms.name: maka-
transforms.description: Ability or chance, actor focus (makakain → kain, makauwi → uwi).

transforms.name: maki-
transforms.description: Joining others, actor focus (makikain → kain).

transforms.name: magpa-
transforms.description: Causative, actor focus (magpaluto → luto, magpaamo → amo).

transforms.name: mapa-
transforms.description: Involuntary action (mapaiyak → iyak).

transforms.name: magka-
transforms.description: Coming to have (magkasakit → sakit).

transforms.name: magpaka-
transforms.description: Making an effort to be (magpakabait → bait).

transforms.name: i-
transforms.description: Conveyance or benefactive focus (isulat → sulat, ibigay → bigay, iabot → abot).

transforms.name: ipag-
transforms.description: Benefactive focus of a mag- verb (ipagluto → luto).

transforms.name: ipa-
transforms.description: Causative, object focus (ipaluto → luto).

transforms.name: ika-
transforms.description: Reason focus, and ordinal numbers (ikagalit → galit, ikalima → lima).

transforms.name: -in verb
transforms.description: The -in infinitive of a completive, which drops the suffix (kinain → kainin, binasa → basahin, ininom → inumin, niluto → lutuin, nilakad → lakarin, binili → bilhin, pinakain → pakainin).

transforms.name: ma- -an
transforms.description: ma- with -an: ability or chance, locative focus (maunawaan → unawa, matandaan → tanda), with d → r (maramdaman → damdam).

transforms.name: maka- -an
transforms.description: maka- with -an: ability or chance, locative focus (makalimutan → limot, makaabutan → abot).

transforms.name: -in
transforms.description: Object focus -in, -hin after a vowel, with u for the o of the last syllable (kainin → kain, basahin → basa, inumin → inom, lutuin → luto), and the verbs whose root loses a vowel (bilhin → bili, kunin → kuha).

transforms.name: -an
transforms.description: Locative or directional focus -an, -han or -nan after a vowel, with u for the o of the last syllable (sulatan → sulat, puntahan → punta, tawanan → tawa, sagutan → sagot), d → r (bayaran → bayad), and the verbs whose root loses a vowel (bigyan → bigay, buksan → bukas).

transforms.name: ma- -in
transforms.description: Adjectives with ma- and -in: given to (madasalin → dasal, matiisin → tiis, madamdamin → damdam, maramdamin → damdam).

transforms.name: pa- -an
transforms.description: Causative pa- with -an (pagalitan → galit, paniwalaan → niwala), and pakinggan → kinig.

transforms.name: pag- -an
transforms.description: pag- with -an: locative focus of a mag- verb (pag-usapan → usap, pagsabihan → sabi).

transforms.name: pag- -in
transforms.description: pag- with -in: object focus of a mag- verb (pagsabihin → sabi, pagbuhatin → buhat).

transforms.name: pa- -in
transforms.description: Causative pa- with -in (pakainin → kain, patulugin → tulog).

transforms.name: ka- -an
transforms.description: Abstract and collective nouns with ka- and -an, and ka- -an verbs (kagandahan → ganda, kalayaan → laya, kalungkutan → lungkot, kamuhian → muhi).

transforms.name: pag-
transforms.description: Verbal nouns with pag- (pagbasa → basa, pag-ibig → ibig), with the reduplicated first syllable (pagbabasa → basa, pag-aaral → aral), pagka-, pagkaka-, pagpapa- and pakikipag- (pagkakamali → mali, pakikipag-usap → usap).

transforms.name: paki-
transforms.description: A polite request (pakisara → sara, pakiabot → abot).

transforms.name: naka-
transforms.description: A state or position (nakaupo → upo, nakabukas → bukas).

transforms.name: pinaka-
transforms.description: Superlative (pinakamaganda → maganda, pinakamalaki → malaki).

transforms.name: napaka-
transforms.description: Very, with the root of a ma- adjective (napakaganda → maganda, ganda).

transforms.name: kasing-
transforms.description: As … as: kasing-, kasin- or kasim- with the root of an adjective (kasingganda → maganda, ganda; kasinlaki → malaki).

transforms.name: taga-
transforms.description: The one who does something, or someone from a place (tagaluto → luto, taga-Maynila → Maynila).

transforms.name: pang-
transforms.description: pang- for an instrument or purpose, which merges with the root's first consonant (pang-araw-araw, panulat → sulat, pambansa → bansa).

transforms.name: mapag-
transforms.description: Inclined to (mapagmahal → mahal), and mapag- verbs (mapagtanto → tanto).

transforms.name: tig-
transforms.description: Each, with numbers (tig-isa → isa, tigdalawa → dalawa).

transforms.name: ka-
transforms.description: ka- with an adjective root, in gaano ka- and kay ka- (gaano katagal → tagal, kalaki → laki, karami → dami), and fellow (kapareho → pareho).

transforms.name: pa-
transforms.description: pa- for a direction or manner, and nouns (paligid → ligid, pataas → taas, papuri → puri, parangal → dangal).

transforms.name: pala-
transforms.description: Fond of, inclined to (palatanong → tanong, palabiro → biro).

transforms.name: tag-
transforms.description: Seasons and times (tag-init → init, tag-ulan → ulan, tagsibol → sibol).

transforms.name: hyphenated
transforms.description: hyphenated form of words
